newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Dec-Feb temperatures seen average.
newsitem.headline: Japan Dec-Feb temperatures seen average.

text.p: Temperatures throughout Japan are forecast to be average during the December to February period, the Meteorological Agency said in its three-month forecast on Wednesday.
Areas facing the Pacific can expect many sunny days in December, while regions along the Sea of Japan coast can expect many cloudy, rainy or snowy days, it said.
Northern Japan can expect lower-than-average temperatures and heavier-than-average rainfall in December, while other regions are likely to see average temperatures and rainfall, the agency said.

In January and February, areas facing the Pacific are likely to see plenty of sunshine, which is normal for that period, while the weather in areas along the Sea of Japan coast is expected to be mostly cloudy, rainy or snowy, the agency said.
Temperatures and rainfall are likely to be average during the two months, it said.
